source.title: Irish News, 24 April 1930, p. 5 ("More nominations in Tyrone: Dungannon and Omagh Boards"); Belfast News-Letter, 25 April 1930, p. 8
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: nominations read on the block images of the Irish News (24 April 1930, p. 5, article INW19300424.2.110), labels as printed; 'so far as Rural District Councils and Boards of Guardians are concerned, there were no opposed returns in Castlederg and Dungannon' (Belfast News-Letter, 25 April 1930, p. 8)

note: Triennial election of the Dungannon rural district councillors, 1930. Mr. Wm. M'Guffin, returning officer, received one nomination for each of the nineteen divisions (Irish News, 24 April 1930, p. 5); there were no opposed returns in Dungannon (Belfast News-Letter, 25 April 1930, p. 8). No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 4 June 1930. Returned unopposed.
